title: fix(app-shell): a position decision output lists the position registry and commits position names (objectui#7611)
body:
Part of #7611
Clause-②: no

Item 3a of the C9 remainder census on #7611 (comment 6111307114), dispatched by the seat's answer 6111342697 as PR-2a. Item 3b, the spec-derived approver readers, waits on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22865 and is not in this PR, so #7611 remains open.

## What changes

- **The typed table entry is rewritten.** In `decisionOutputParams`, `position` leaves `OUTPUT_LOOKUP_OBJECTS`, which keeps `department` and `team`, and becomes the one entry of a new `OUTPUT_REGISTRY_TYPES` table: a catalog kind. Nothing else in the diff names `position`.
- **A catalog-kind output renders a `select`** over the registry items the caller passes as `registry`. Each option's value is the item's machine name and its label is the item's `label`, else its name. Items without a name are dropped, and the list is sorted by name. This is the same reading `RecipientPickerField`'s registry kinds make of the same registry (ADR-0131 D3/D7, objectui#12089).
- **`readDecisionOutputRegistry`** reads those items through the console's metadata store, `ensureType('position')`, once per type. A failed read maps to an empty list. `decisionOutputsReadRegistry` says whether any output is a catalog kind.
- **`DeclaredActionsBar` is the one decision surface.** The Approval Center and the record page both mount it. It reads the store raw from `MetadataCtx`. Only a decision with a catalog output awaits the registry read; every other decision still dispatches in the click's own tick.
- **Without a metadata store** (a host outside a MetadataProvider), a position output degrades to the free-text box an untyped output gets. The recipient picker takes the same fallback. An empty registry is a different case: it renders the select with no options.
- **No new param key and no new widget.** `select` is a declared param type, and `resolveActionParams()` copies its `options` through key by key.
- **A comment made false is fixed.** The `decision_output_defs` docblock in apps/console's `approvalsApi.ts` said position values are record ids. It now says position commits machine names.

## Measured in a browser

Setup:
- The showcase was booted from objectstack `origin/main` `8532783f65` with `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`. It ran in a detached worktree; the closure build was 60 of 60 tasks cached.
- Two consoles ran under vite with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET` pointed at it: one from this branch, and one from the base `a7d492011` for the before leg.
- On the fresh database, `GET /api/v1/data/sys_position` answers `"records":[]` with `"total":0`, and `GET /api/v1/meta/position` serves 16 positions.

The pending approval:
- A flow, `pr2a_position_output`, was saved at runtime with `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/pr2a_position_output`. It has two approval steps.
- Step one, `lead_review`, declares `decisionOutputs: [{ key: 'parallel_positions', type: 'position', multiple: true, required: true }]`.
- Step two, `co_sign`, has the approver `{ type: 'expression', value: 'vars.lead_review.parallel_positions', resolveAs: 'position' }`.
- Editing an announcement's body opened a pending request whose `decision_output_defs` carries the position output.

**Before (base `a7d492011`).** Checked on the Approval Center and on the record page:
- The Approve dialog's Parallel Positions control is the lookup.
- Opening it sends `GET /api/v1/data/sys_position?top=50` and shows "No options found".
- The output is required, so the approval cannot complete.

**After (this branch).** Checked on the Approval Center and on the record page:
- Clicking Approve sends `GET /api/v1/meta/position` and sends nothing to `sys_position`.
- The control offers all 16 positions by label.
- Confirm with nothing picked is refused: "Parallel Positions is required".
- Picking Auditor and Project Manager and confirming sends `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID/approve` with the body `{"outputs":{"parallel_positions":["auditor","manager"]}}`.

**The engine routes by those names:**
- The approved request's `node_config_json` stores `__decisionOutputs: {"parallel_positions":["auditor","manager"]}`.
- The `co_sign` request opened with `pending_approvers` set to the users who hold `auditor` and `manager` in `sys_user_position`: the demo auditor and the admin.

The after leg ran at `87aa90858`, then again at `4223b14c0` on a second fresh database. Both runs sent the same wire body and opened the same downstream slate. `6eb495c67` changes only when the bar awaits the read, and a position output still awaits it. The pins and the ablation table below cover that commit.

Not on the wire: the replaced lookup committed `sys_position` row ids (LookupField's default id field). That is read from code. A fresh database has no rows, so there was nothing to commit.

## Tests (head `6eb495c67`)

- **Related suites: 29 files, 308 tests passed.** They are every test file under `packages/app-shell` and `apps/console` that names `DeclaredActionsBar`, a decision output, or `ApprovalDecisionPanel`. The list was enumerated by `git grep -l` and covers the Approval Center page, the record page's approval actions and the override-affordance suite.
- **`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0.** That is `tsc --noEmit` plus `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. Run with `--listFilesOnly`, the test program lists both edited test files.
- **Gates, all exit 0:**
  - `check-changeset-presence` (5 source files, 2 released packages, 1 changeset) and `check-changeset-no-major`;
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check:control-bytes`;
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `check:test-path-roots`;
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:shell-escape-residue` and `check:spec-symbols`.
- **eslint, narrowed to the 5 changed source files: 0 errors.**
  - Against the base, the only new warnings are 2 `no-explicit-any`, on the `as any` action fixtures the test file's other cases also use.
  - The narrowing proves itself in three parts. The 5 files are in the population: eslint returned a result for each, and none was reported as ignored. The count of 5 is read from `--format json`. The root `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch.

## One-time ablations

Every leg ran through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. The anchor had to hit, the blob had to change, and the restore was proven: blob equal to HEAD, and an empty `git diff HEAD`. No dist was involved, because vitest aliases every `@object-ui/*` package to its `src`.

| Mutation | Run at | Pins that went red |
|---|---|---|
| Drop `position` from `OUTPUT_REGISTRY_TYPES` | `87aa90858`, `6eb495c67` | 9, then 10: every registry pin, the predicate, the read-once and failed-read pins, the bar's registry pin, and the label, multiplicity and never-degrades pins |
| The bar passes no registry | `87aa90858`, `6eb495c67` | the bar's "lists the position registry" pin |
| A failed read leaves the type absent | `87aa90858` | "answers `{}` without a reader, and `[]` for a read that fails" |
| No sort | `87aa90858` | the offers pin, the widget-values pin and the bar's registry pin |
| Label is always the name | `87aa90858` | the offers pin and the bar's registry pin |
| An absent registry reads as `[]` | `87aa90858` | "no registry reader degrades to the free-text box" |
| A second read per type | `87aa90858` | the read-once pin and the bar's registry pin |
| Read every typed output, not only catalog kinds | `87aa90858` | the read-once pin and "reads nothing when no output is a catalog kind" |
| Keep empty-name items | `87aa90858`, `4686fb7dd` | none at first, then 2 (see below) |
| Fold joins arrays | `87aa90858` | "folds the picked names into the decide body unchanged" and the existing fold pin |
| The bar awaits whenever a store is mounted | `6eb495c67` | "dispatches in the click's own tick when no output lists the registry" |
| The predicate answers true for any output | `6eb495c67` | the predicate pin and the click's-own-tick pin |

Two legs did not measure on the first try:
- **The empty-name mutation stayed green.** The fixture had no item whose name is an empty string. `4686fb7dd` adds one, and the rerun went red on 2 pins.
- **The tool refused the first await-guard leg before any test ran.** Its replacement text was already a prefix of the anchor, so the replacement count could not rise. The rerun used a distinct replacement and went red as listed.

## Not measured here, declared for CI

- **The full app-shell package suite.** A run at `4223b14c0` was stopped after about 11 minutes: it held the shared verification lock while another agent waited behind it. Before it stopped, it had reported one red file, `DeclaredActionsBar.overrideAffordance` (3 failed). That suite reads the dispatch synchronously after its click, so awaiting on every decision broke it. `6eb495c67` keeps the dispatch synchronous unless a catalog output exists, and the file is green in the 29-file run.
- **Full `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, and the console's `type-check`.** The console change is a comment.

## Acceptance notes

- **Audience positions in the list (read from code, not measured).** The list includes the registry's built-in audience positions `everyone` and `guest`. The engine's `expandPositionUsers` reads `sys_user_position` rows plus the membership tier, so a position held only implicitly probably resolves to nobody, and a run that picked one would route into `onEmptyApprovers`. The sharing-rule recipient picker offers the same list. Successor: none.
- **Option order.** Options are sorted by machine name, so the labels are not alphabetical: "Project Manager" sits between "Legal" and "Operations". This follows `RecipientPickerField`. Polish, noted only.
- **Chip group.** A `multiple` output renders as a chip group (`MultiSelectField`), which was 16 chips on the showcase. Polish, noted only.

Changeset: `.changeset/7611-decision-output-position-registry.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`, minor). Draft per AGENTS.md section 9: this PR comes from a dispatched claim.
